notes: The FIRRTL `ProbeOp` no longer exists in this checkout (firtool-1.148.0) — probe/ref semantics were redesigned around `ref.send`/`ref.rwprobe`, which LowerTypes handles explicitly — so the reported crash cannot be reproduced and no in-tree code path matches the issue. Additionally, the issue itself leaves the intended resolution open (reject with a nicer error vs. convert to passive vs. expand to scalar elements), and the historically-chosen resolution was to remove the op, so there is no unambiguous "correct behavior" in this tree for a patch to implement or be validated against.
